cases.name: zero_uuid_sentinel
cases.why: The all-zero UUID is the conventional unset sentinel and must still occupy sixteen bytes.

cases.name: real_uuid_and_listeners
cases.why: A non-zero UUID plus a nested listener array, the shape a controller actually sends.

cases.name: v1_ack_when_committed_true
cases.why: v1 adds AckWhenCommitted, whose protocol default is true; the converter requires it present for the version it writes.

cases.name: v1_ack_when_committed_false
cases.why: The non-default value of the field v1 introduced, so its byte is asserted rather than assumed.

cases.name: synthesized_populated_v0
cases.why: Every field this version declares, present and non-default: one element in every array, every nullable thing supplied. The defaults case leaves arrays empty, which hides every field of the struct the array would have held — a records field encoded with the wrong length prefix survived the whole corpus that way, because nothing ever reached the struct holding it.
